audit.whatIsWrong: The chart reads Camille / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Camille while the seven whys next to it describe Urgot / Camille / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot / Camille / Urgot — and the packet chart matches the whys exactly.
audit.why: 56.08% over 781 games with a page whose own prose gives Urgot five of seven stages cannot render as five neutral rows and two Camille rows.
audit.corrected: Urgot / Camille / Urgot / Urgot / Urgot / Camille / Urgot, proposed as one group with the win[N] pairs and ratings. Difficulty pulled from 7/10 to 4/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hookshot is the tracked cooldown on every screen of this page and its number appears nowhere, nor does the fact that it needs a wall.
audit.why: Hookshot is 16s at rank 1, 800 range, pulls her to a wall and knocks up on landing — that wall requirement is why standing in open lane is the answer.
audit.corrected: 16s, the wall requirement and the knockup written into phases[1], spikes[2] and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] calls her second Q 'true-damage'; spikes[1] says Fear Beyond Death's recast 'drags her onto your shrapnel'; spikes[3] credits Corrosive Charge with shred; whys[1] calls the Hookshot landing a stun. Adaptive Defenses and Tactical Sweep's healing are absent entirely.
audit.why: Riot's Precision Protocol text gives bonus damage and move speed with a delayed recast for more damage — no true damage clause. Riot's Fear Beyond Death text is an impale and an execute; there is no drag and no shrapnel. Corrosive Charge deals physical damage and slows. Hookshot knocks up. Adaptive Defenses is a max-health shield typed to the damage that hit her, and Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her — both change the trade maths.
audit.corrected: Fabrications removed, the Precision Protocol auto-reset tell written in, Adaptive Defenses named as the shield to bait with an auto before committing, and Grievous Wounds tied to Tactical Sweep's outer-half healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: _missing lists two claims I did not write: that The Hextech Ultimatum is a channel Disdain or Fear Beyond Death cancels outright, and that it makes her untargetable.
audit.why: Riot's text for it is 'dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area' plus bonus magic damage — no channel, no untargetability. Those are derived-flag misfires, and CC priority against it is not settled by anything in the kits.
audit.corrected: Not written to the page; recorded in unverified instead.

edits.after: Her level: Hookshot knocks up on landing at 16s rank 1 and opens the Q-reset burst. Give the wave and hold Disdain.

edits.before: Once you have Q and E you out-brawl her: Camille wants a short Q-reset trade with her E hookshot, so E her out of the wall-dash animation and W-shred her while her true-damage second Q is on cooldown.
edits.after: Once you have Q and E you out-brawl her: Camille wants the Hookshot-into-Q-reset trade, so bait her Adaptive Defenses shield with one auto first, then Disdain her out and Purge while her second Q is still delayed.

edits.before: At 6 your R Fear Beyond Death answers her all-in; if she E-dashes in, suppress her mid-combo and the recast drags her onto your shrapnel, flipping the fight before her W heal-zone matters.
edits.after: At 6 Fear Beyond Death answers her all-in: impale her as she lands the Hookshot and the execute threshold decides it. Tactical Sweep's outer half heals her, so carry Grievous Wounds into the fight.

edits.before: Camille's first-item Sheen spike (Trinity) is a real power window, so respect the level-2-item-ish burst; don't duel when her E is up, and instead farm and shred her when the hookshot is on cooldown.
edits.after: Camille's first-item Sheen spike is a real power window; don't duel while Hookshot is up on its 16s rank-1 timer. Step up only in that gap — her combo opens on a Precision Protocol auto reset, so read the wind-up.

edits.before: You out-tank her single-target burst late; her E stun and R lockdown are scary, but your HP eats the combo and R execute plus Corrosive shred beat her once she's blown E to get in.
edits.after: You out-tank her single-target burst late; her R anchors you at 475 for the duel, but your HP eats the combo and R plus Corrosive Charge's slow beat her once she has spent Hookshot to get in.

notes: The level chart was the main defect: five neutral rows against a 56.08% lane whose own whys already spelled out the correct shape, which the packet chart confirms row for row. Deliberately NOT written despite being in _missing: The Hextech Ultimatum described as an interruptible channel your Disdain or R cancels, and as an untargetability window. Riot's text for it is a dash that anchors the target plus bonus magic damage on her attacks — neither claim is in the description, so both are derived-flag misfires. Precision Protocol's 'trueDamage' flag is likewise absent from Riot's text and I removed the existing true-damage claim rather than repeat it.
